sql_query:
WITH max_dt AS (
  SELECT MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS max_ts
  FROM orders o
)
SELECT
  TO_CHAR(DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month,
  ABS(SUM(oi.price * 1))::numeric AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN max_dt m ON TRUE
WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= (DATE_TRUNC('month', m.max_ts) - INTERVAL '11 months')
  AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <= m.max_ts
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)
ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp);
